messages:
maria: Quick design check — putting this in #product. I updated the Key Management table row to show a 'Key owner' badge + a small 'Manage' affordance. Screenshot mock: https://figma.redwood/xyz. Please look for copy, focus order, and hover disclosure content. jonathan: thanks — quick Q: should 'Manage' be a button or link? tldr it triggers a modal. alex: prefer button for affordance. If it's a modal, use role='button' and aria-haspopup='dialog'. sam: security nit — 'Manage' should show key origin (BYOK vs Redwood-managed) and last rotation timestamp in the hover. Avoid exposing key IDs in tooltip. lee: a11y — hover-only content is inaccessible. Ensure focusable and visible on keyboard (on focus/enter). Also aria-describedby from the 'Manage' control to the disclosure content. maria: agreed. Proposed tooltip copy: "Key origin: Customer-managed (BYOK). Last rotated: 2025-03-18. Audit events available in the security logs." jonathan: wording feels long for tooltip. Suggest shorter: "Customer key (BYOK) · rotated Mar 18, 2025 · view logs" sam: +1 but 'view logs' should be a focused link that opens audit log filtered to that key — no raw IDs. alex: implementation note: ```
...
``` Keyboard flow: Tab -> Manage -> Enter opens modal. Tooltip shown on hover/focus. lee: also test high contrast and screen reader readout: tooltip should announce "Key details for ". maria: other console bits: region picker in the key row — currently shows region code 'eu-west-1'. Suggest show friendly name 'Europe (Ireland)' and fallback when region unmapped: 'Unknown region — contact support'. jonathan: retention+nits: in same modal we show retention policy preview. Use 'Data retention: 45 days' not 'Retention: 45'. Also add link to policy page. sam: audit log copy: change 'User accessed key' -> 'Key access: successful' and include actor and reason where available. Timestamp ordering is weird in logs — prefer ISO with timezone in UI (Mar 18 2025 14:23 UTC). alex: will mock small changes, pushing patch to PR #4123. pinging @maria for microcopy final. maria: thanks. I'll assemble copy and send final snippet. small todo: ensure the 'Manage' control has visible focus ring and that the disclosure modal traps focus. :white_check_mark: ops-bot: Deploy preview built for branch feature/key-row-nits — https://preview.redwood.com/preview/feature/key-row-nits :rocket: jonathan: nice. timeline? we can ship as part of next console patch. maria: aiming EOD Friday for copy. thx all.
